# Upstream license of the vendored RDF Messages test suite

`messages-tests.bs` and `messages.bs` are copies of the files `spec/messages-tests.bs` and
`spec/messages.bs` of <https://github.com/w3c-cg/rsp> at the commit recorded in `UPSTREAM.json`.
They are the sources of the specification documents
<https://w3c-cg.github.io/rsp/spec/messages> and <https://w3c-cg.github.io/rsp/spec/messages-tests>
by Pieter Colpaert and Piotr Sowiński (W3C RDF Stream Processing Community Group).

The upstream repository states:

> All Reports in this Repository are licensed by Contributors under the
> [W3C Software and Document License](https://www.w3.org/copyright/software-license/).
>
> Contributions to Specifications are made under the [W3C CLA](https://www.w3.org/community/about/process/cla/).
>
> Contributions to Test Suites are made under the
> [W3C 3-clause BSD License](https://www.w3.org/copyright/3-clause-bsd-license-2008/)

Additionally, the editors have made the specification available under the Open Web Foundation
Agreement Version 1.0. The files are included unmodified, for reproducible conformance testing only.
